productInfo.title: Nova Ai-Studio
productInfo.brandCaption: Nova Ai Studio 2.0 · Enterprise agent platform
productInfo.tagline: A conversation-driven AI workspace for complex work in natural language.
productInfo.intro: Nova Ai-Studio is a conversation-driven AI workspace that helps you handle research, creation, office work, and development through natural language.

agent-harness.title: Agent Harness — complex work, delivered
agent-harness.heroSubtitle: Skills and MCP in one chain—image, video, and web fetch orchestrated automatically, with outputs landing in artifacts/ instantly.

conversation.title: One prompt, a full project
conversation.heroSubtitle: From instruction to deliverables—reports, designs, and scripts—conversation is the workflow.
conversation.summary: Natural language straight to complete project outputs

token-savings.title: Smart routing saves tokens
token-savings.heroSubtitle: Hard steps use flagship models; polish and layout use lighter models—up to ~70% token savings in official benchmarks without sacrificing quality.
token-savings.summary: Flagship for hard tasks, light models for easy ones—up to ~70% saved

flywheel.title: Marketing flywheel, six stages
flywheel.heroSubtitle: Research → strategy → creative → reach → publish → monitor—one continuous loop.
flywheel.summary: End-to-end marketing from research to monitoring

research-growth.title: Deep research, smart acquisition
research-growth.heroSubtitle: Multi-source queries and market intel in one pass—lead profiles auto-organized so you find and reach the right customers.
research-growth.summary: Powerful research and intelligent acquisition in one loop

capabilities.title: 400+ ready-to-use capabilities
capabilities.heroSubtitle: Marketing, office, creation, development, and education—five hubs, one click away.
capabilities.summary: Five capability hubs, ready when you are

models.title: Top global models, one pool
models.heroSubtitle: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Seedream, and more—unified access with task-aware routing.
models.summary: Leading models unified and routed per task

pipeline.title: Full-case templates, one click
pipeline.heroSubtitle: Not sure where to start? Nearly 30 proven templates from outline to deck to video.
pipeline.summary: Nearly 30 templates from outline to video in one run

security.title: Enterprise-grade security
security.heroSubtitle: Tenant isolation for projects and memory, JWT auth, tool allowlists, sandboxed Always-On workspaces, and usage attribution—engine-level sandboxing plus SaaS isolation.
security.summary: Tenant isolation, permission sandbox, and usage audit
